operatorApproval.notes: Worker panes: t02 (claude-opus-5) died at start with 'No API key found for anthropic' on this host, so the unit ran as t02b (pane w8:pA, metabolomics/qwen3.8-flash_next) on base 145549b5. It changed src/plannerWorker/contract.ts so authorization-origin denies arriving on scope.forbidden_authorization and authorization.denied are never discarded: a grant wholly inside such a deny rejects the contract naming both sides, a narrowing deny is kept and tagged in scope.forbiddenAuthorization, and planner-origin scope.forbidden keeps its base keep/discard semantics because a planner note can only narrow its own contract. Conductor review found the first commit reused the lenient stringList on the authorization channels, so denied:[42] became a deny pattern named '42' and denied:[true] one named 'true' — a fail-open host channel inventing denies from junk; the worker amended the commit to require an array of non-empty strings per channel with an index-naming refusal, leaving planner leniency untouched. Verified independently (logs/10): [42]/[true]/['src/secret/**',7] and a bare string all refused, a well-formed array accepted and tagged, the plan's named regression (broad grant + restricted subtree keeps the deny; explicit re-grant inside it rejected), planner-origin coercion unchanged.
